stories.title: Trump dismisses AI guardrails, blasts Anthropic's Amodei, calls safety concerns a 'sick conspiracy'
stories.reason: Trump said the only guardrail AI needs is 'a STRONG AND SMART President,' directly rebuking Amodei's call to pace AI development days after Microsoft's Nadella voiced support for it -- exposing a widening rift between Washington and parts of the AI industry.

stories.title: Anthropic locks down $517 billion in compute deals ahead of IPO, nearly tripling prior guidance
stories.reason: The compute commitments, up from the $180 billion Anthropic told investors to expect through 2029, secure at least 14.8 gigawatts of capacity even as its own CEO publicly argues the industry should slow down.

stories.title: SoftBank secures $11.87 billion loan for its OpenAI bet as shares plunge 13% on AI safety concerns
stories.reason: The upsized two-year facility from roughly 20 banks exceeded SoftBank's original $10 billion target, underscoring how deep Masayoshi Son has committed to OpenAI even as investors punish the stock over the industry's own safety warnings.

stories.title: Anthropic, OpenAI and Google have held quiet talks since July on a joint AI safety standards body
stories.reason: The rivals are discussing a FINRA-style self-regulatory model proposed by DeepMind's Demis Hassabis, though they remain split on how much government involvement it should have -- a sign the slowdown debate is pushing toward concrete institutions, not just essays.

stories.title: Netanyahu-Lapid meeting 'blows up' over how to fund Israel's increased defense budget
stories.reason: Lapid said he'd back more IDF funding only if it comes from ultra-Orthodox coalition budgets rather than taxes on the middle class and reservists, reopening a fault line in Israeli politics as the multi-front war drags into its seventh month.

stories.title: Iranian cargo vessel struck near Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz, killing one crew member
stories.reason: Tehran blamed a 'terrorist enemy' for the unclaimed strike, which also forced the postponement of planned Oman-hosted talks between Iran and Gulf states over the blockaded strait.

stories.title: Indonesia races to find 129 people missing after a ferry capsized in the Java Sea
stories.reason: The Virgo Transport 8 was carrying more than 240 people in rough 3-meter seas when it capsized; 622 personnel on 17 vessels and five aircraft are now searching the wreck as strong currents hamper the effort.

stories.title: North Korea says its live-fire drill of missiles, drones and artillery demonstrated 'huge destructive power'
stories.reason: The drill fired multiple weapons simultaneously to test overwhelming South Korean and US air defenses, coming a day after a trilateral US-South Korea-Japan exercise Pyongyang called a provocation.
